A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

, we propose to treat a SSLF for static scenes as a video captured by the virtual camera moving along parallax axis, and we propose a novel parallax interpolation method based on the AdaSep Conv method, which is a state of the-art video frame interpolation method.
the proposed PIASC method can effectively improve the performance of video frame interpolation algorithms for DSLF reconstruction.
the proposed PIASC method, by taking full advantage of the temporal coherence of static objects in the SSLF, can significantly improve the reconstruction performance of static scenes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the motion coherence of the static objects in a SSLF can be exploited by a video interpolation method to enhance the performance of DSLF reconstruction.

the parallax view generation of static scenes using parallax view interpolation can be achieved with a high quality by treating the angular information of a SSLF as the temporal information in a video captured by an virtual camera moving along parallax axis.
